title: Quiz: Query Review Checklist
description: Check your understanding of Query Review Checklist.

questions.question: Which of these is the correct way to write a comment in SQL?
questions.explanation: In SQL, -- marks a comment. Block comments use /* */.

questions.question: What replaces OFFSET for deep pagination at scale?
questions.correctAnswer: Keyset/cursor pagination on an indexed column

questions.question: True or False: OFFSET scans and discards all skipped rows — cursors seek directly.
What is the main purpose of the Query Review Checklist technique shown in this lesson?
questions.explanation: It exists to help you query review checklist effectively.

questions.question: In SQL, what is the safest way to predict what a program outputs?
options: Depends on the code — trace it line by line
questions.correctAnswer: Depends on the code — trace it line by line
questions.explanation: Read top to bottom, track variable values, and note every output statement.
